conclusion: Present the existing pooled performance and per-core variation without changing model selection or numerical values.

evidence.performance_official_default: GMM and two Nimbus models at strict score > 0.5; internal and external panels.
evidence.performance_validation_selected: Two Nimbus models at thresholds selected on the internal development set.
evidence.per_core_F1: The same 42 external cores in image_id order; descriptive paired model performance.

statistics: One Nimbus seed; descriptive cell-pooled metrics, no confidence intervals or cell-level significance tests. Cores are not claimed to be independent patients.
risks: Do not confuse the internal threshold-development result with unbiased validation.
No numerical recomputation, model change, external threshold selection or image manipulation.
